content_data.project_title: E-commerce Content Strategy Revitalization for Global Market Penetration
content_data.project_description: A comprehensive proposal outlining a revised content strategy to enhance brand presence, drive engagement, and improve conversion rates across diverse international e-commerce markets.
content_data.timeline: Over the next 9 months, structured into three phases.
objectives: Increase organic search visibility by 25% in target international markets within the first six months.
Establish a consistent and compelling brand voice adaptable to cultural nuances.
Improve content engagement metrics (time on page, bounce rate) by 15% across key product categories.
Drive a 10% uplift in conversion rates attributable to content initiatives.
Streamline content creation workflows to support rapid market expansion.
deliverables: Comprehensive Global Content Strategy Document (including audience personas, content pillars, and channel strategy)
Editorial Calendar for the upcoming 6 months
Localized Content Style Guides for 3 key international markets
Pilot Content Package (e.g., 5 localized blog posts, 3 product landing page rewrites, social media content templates)
